representation_fit.evidence: Layered node-link dependency map matches the relational-web bundle (many / high relationality / medium hierarchy / no comparison): 4 tier columns, 24 nodes, 40 typed edges all resident (screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900; source/index.html:41-42 aria-label '四层 24 个服务、40 条依赖关系，全部常驻可见'). The brief's suggested primary object 'relationship' is first-class: edges are individually selectable with a dedicated inspector (source/app.js:119-121, 308-311, 261-275) and typed call/data/critical (source/data.js:47-88, legend source/index.html:59-64).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by the full-graph map (~75% width, both viewports); the empty-state inspector states the brief's job verbatim — click service node or dependency line, then '试试从 order-service 出发，沿「依赖」或「被依赖」逐跳跟随' (source/index.html:72-73); tagline '跟随依赖与影响 · 全局上下文始终可见' (source/index.html:19); context bar '全局视图 · 24 服务 · 40 依赖关系 · 全部可见' (screenshot 1280x860).

time_to_understand.evidence: What/where is conveyed immediately: T1–T4 tier labels, 4-item legend, and the arrow-semantics note 'A → B 表示「A 依赖 B」；B 变更时，影响沿箭头反方向…传播' (screenshots; source/index.html:59-65), plus a concrete guided first hop (source/index.html:73). Deduction: the T3→T4 region is a dense crossing hairball and the semantics-carrying footnote is 11.5px faint text (source/styles.css:116-117). Model-judged proxy per rubric, not a human measurement.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object reachable in one action from the initial screen — every node and edge is permanently visible and directly clickable (screenshots); keyboard equivalents via tabindex+Enter/Space on nodes and edge hit-paths (source/app.js:119-121, 131-134, 331-336); '/' focuses search and picking a result selects in place without leaving the map (source/app.js:369-371, 433-437); hash deep-links #follow/#select/#impact reach a state directly (source/app.js:460-495). No modes, tabs, or drill-down pages.

context_loss.evidence: The acceptance seed is the stated core discipline: 'dim-to-focus，从不移除节点/边' (source/app.js:2) — updateView only toggles classes (source/app.js:161-187), dimmed items stay in place at opacity .13/.1 (source/styles.css:136,152); the context bar reports 'N / 24 服务清晰 · 其余置灰仍在原位' (source/app.js:192-200); the trail bar keeps every followed step as a clickable chip with direction separators (source/app.js:204-228, 312-317); Esc/reset restores the global view (source/app.js:365-372). Per rubric this dimension is judged from source/UI structure; populated interaction states were not screenshotted.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent chrome is minimal relative to the job: topbar with search, one filter checkbox, one reset button (source/index.html:22-30); one trailbar carrying the context readout (source/index.html:33-37); map with legend/footnote (source/index.html:58-66); one inspector panel (source/index.html:69-77). No tabs, modes, or decorative panels; on-map density is the data (40 edges), not UI surface.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size (measurement-summary.json:13-15). Structural effort is visible in source — role/aria-label with dependency counts on every node and edge (source/app.js:119-134), focus-visible outlines (source/styles.css:80,141,146), aria-live context (source/index.html:34), combobox/listbox search semantics (source/index.html:24-25) — but secondary text is small and faint (node-zh 10.5px #8496b8 source/styles.css:155; footnote 11.5px --faint #5f6f92 source/styles.css:45,116-117) and tab order traverses all 40 invisible edge hit-paths before any node (source/app.js:117-140), consistent with the focus_order fail.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible overflow, clipping, or truncation at either viewport (screenshots 1280x860, 1440x900; layout.overflow pass, text.truncation pass — measurement-summary.json:11-13). But layout.responsive_collision and type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json:12,16): the fixed 1340x860 viewBox (source/index.html:41) scales to ~0.7x inside the 1280 viewport minus the 344px inspector column (source/styles.css:109), projecting 10.5px sub-labels far below minimum size — a defect class that implies layout/typography rework rather than a one-line fix.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' and success criterion '依赖与影响可跟随' are directly implemented: both directions followable via closure('dep')/closure('impact') with 高亮影响面 / 高亮依赖闭包 actions (source/app.js:44-62, 248-257); edge inspector quantifies propagation '变更将波及 X 及其全部上游依赖方（N 项）' (source/app.js:270-271); map aria-label '全部常驻可见' (source/index.html:42); state-ready at load with inline data and synchronous render, no loading state (source/index.html:9-10, source/app.js:511-515).

defects_observed: type.min_projected_size: fail — node sub-labels 10.5px (source/styles.css:155) and legend/footnote 11.5px (source/styles.css:116-117) project below minimum at 1280x860
a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size all fail (measurement-summary.json:13-15); 5 of 7 checks fail overall (measurement-summary.json:4-6)
Tab order puts all 40 invisible edge hit-paths before the 24 nodes (source/app.js:117-140)
Dense edge crossings in the T3→T4 band make individual relations hard to trace visually (both screenshots)
scores.overall_note: impl-12 is a single-screen SVG dependency map ('DepAtlas') organized around the brief's discriminator: relationships are first-class selectable objects (source/app.js:119-121, 261-275) and every following action uses dim-to-focus so all 24 nodes and 40 edges stay resident and in place (source/app.js:2, 161-187; context readout source/app.js:192-200), which is exactly the acceptance seed. The initial screen is self-explanatory within seconds via tier labels, legend, arrow-semantics note, and a guided first hop (source/index.html:59-73), with one-click/keyboard/deep-link access to any object. The measured weaknesses are concentrated in rendering quality rather than concept: 5 of 7 receipt checks fail (measurement-summary.json:4-6), comprising all three a11y checks (contrast, focus_order, target_size) plus responsive-collision and minimum-type-size fails that are consistent with the small, faint secondary typography (10.5–11.5px, source/styles.css:116,155) and the fixed 1340x860 viewBox scaling beside a fixed 344px inspector (source/index.html:41, source/styles.css:109); layout.overflow and text.truncation pass and no layout defect is visible at either viewport. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this pilot; time_to_understand here is a model-judged proxy and implies nothing about human preference.
